name: @theaiinc/realm
description: Realm — isolated AI execution environment platform

scripts.build: corepack pnpm --filter @theaiinc/realm-core build && corepack pnpm --filter @theaiinc/realm-container build && corepack pnpm --filter @theaiinc/realm-cloudrun build && corepack pnpm --filter @theaiinc/realm-api build && corepack pnpm --filter @theaiinc/realm-cli build && corepack pnpm --filter @theaiinc/realm-browser build && corepack pnpm --filter @theaiinc/realm-veil build && corepack pnpm --filter @theaiinc/realm-cloudflare typecheck
scripts.test: cd packages/realm-core && npx vitest run && cd ../../packages/realm-container && npx vitest run && cd ../../packages/realm-browser && npx vitest run && cd ../../packages/realm-veil && npx vitest run && cd ../../packages/realm-api && npx vitest run && cd ../../packages/realm-cloudflare && npx vitest run
